daily.today_energy: The cosmos is nudging you toward authenticity today. Your vibe is magnetic when you stop overthinking and just *be*. Trust the timing of your life—everything's unfolding exactly as it should.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the real you beneath the layers. Whether single or coupled, there's an invitation to vulnerability that feels surprisingly safe. Let people in a little closer than usual.
daily.career: Your unconventional ideas are your superpower right now. Don't dim yourself to fit the room—the right people are actually waiting for exactly what you bring. Share that wild vision.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels like play, not punishment. Dance, stretch, walk—whatever makes you feel alive. Your energy thrives when you're having fun, not grinding.

weekly.overview: Mercury's dancing through your zone of self-expression this week, bestie. You're radiating that main character energy—trust the vibe shift happening internally. Channel this clarity into projects that actually matter to you.
weekly.love: Your authenticity is literally magnetic rn. Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability hits different this week. Let someone see the real you behind the cool exterior. Connections deepen when you stop performing.
weekly.career: Ideas are flowing but resist the urge to scatter yourself everywhere. Pick one meaningful direction and commit to it. Your unique perspective is your superpower—don't dilute it trying to please everyone's expectations.
weekly.health: Your nervous system's asking for gentler rhythms. Less doom-scrolling, more actual rest. Movement that feels good (not punishing) will shift your whole energy. Listen to what your body needs, not what you think it should want.
